shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books on the weekend.
My favorite season of the year is autumn.
I like to cook new recipes for dinner.
Traveling to new places is always exciting for me.
I often listen to music while I work or study.
Going for walks helps me clear my mind and relax.
I believe learning a new language opens many doors.
My friends and I love to play board games on Fridays.
Finding a balance between work and hobbies can be challenging.
Volunteering in my community has been a rewarding experience.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling to that destination?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts a person's worldview?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip abroad?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: What motivated you to become more environmentally conscious?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in adopting eco-friendly habits?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to protect the environment?
Q4: What steps can individuals take to live a more sustainable lifestyle?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies related to art.
questions: Q1: What type of art do you enjoy creating or experiencing?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles while pursuing your art hobby?
Q3: How do you think engaging with art benefits mental health?
Q4: What tips would you offer someone who wants to start an art hobby?
